subject.title: When calling a VLLM model, the usage page statistics show no data. How can I calculate usage and cost when using VLLM?

question: For vLLM and other local OpenAI-compatible providers, should OpenClaw treat missing local pricing as a documentation/configuration issue, or add a product-visible unknown-pricing warning/marker beyond the current aggregate missing-cost handling?
rationale: Source shows token usage support and existing local cost configuration, while the remaining cost behavior depends on the maintained pricing contract for local/free/unknown-cost models.

options.title: Require evidence first
options.body: Keep this issue open for raw stream, transcript, Usage API, screenshot, and pricing evidence before changing core behavior.

options.title: Canonicalize under unknown pricing
options.body: Move the cost-calculation decision to https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/90674 and close this only after evidence shows the blank page was only missing-pricing behavior.

options.title: Add a new warning contract
options.body: Define a per-turn or UI-level unknown-pricing marker for vLLM/local models, with tests that avoid misclassifying intentional free models.

recommendation.title: Require evidence first
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open for raw stream, transcript, Usage API, screenshot, and pricing evidence before changing core behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: Most connected to the current usage-cost summaries and the merged vLLM streaming-usage fix.
